scientific_integrity: The universal theorem is proved by explicit positive John-contact weights and matrix identities, with finite symbolic and numerical checks supplied separately.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to equal-sized two-level antichains and the standard Euclidean embedding. It does not address unequally sized or multi-level posets, independently certify novelty, or classify their optimal ellipsoids.
title: Exact John ellipsoid of balanced two-layer order polytopes
